u203.name: On Thin Ice
u203.note: Soshage EN affiche ce trait en portugais. Base et 5★ = captures du jeu ; 1★ à 4★ traduits du portugais sur le modèle du 5★.
base: Ignores [Frosty] tile effects and gains the [Wardpiercer - Frostlands] effect.
At the start of the battle, summons [Icefang]. After it is defeated, automatically re-summons at the start of the 2nd turn. Can be summoned up to 1 time per battle.
Gains [Keen Eye] and [Oathbound Resolve]. At the end of the turn, if on a [Frosty] tile, recovers 1 NRG.

1: Increases DEF by 10%. 20% of P.DEF is added to P.ATK.
At the start of the battle, recovers 1 NRG.
2: Increases DEF by 20%. 30% of P.DEF is added to P.ATK.
At the start of the battle, recovers 1 NRG.
3: Increases DEF by 20%. 30% of P.DEF is added to P.ATK.
At the start of the battle, recovers 2 NRG; when [Frost Spike] or [Exploding Earth Spikes] is triggered, additionally recovers 1 NRG. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.
4: Increases DEF by 30%. 40% of P.DEF is added to P.ATK.
At the start of the battle, recovers 2 NRG; when [Frost Spike] or [Exploding Earth Spikes] is triggered, additionally recovers 1 NRG. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.
5: Increases DEF by 30%. 40% of P.DEF is added to P.ATK.

At the start of the battle, recovers 2 NRG; when [Frost Spike] or [Exploding Earth Spikes] is triggered, increases [Piercing DMG] dealt by 20% and additionally recovers 1 NRG. Can be triggered up to 2 times per round.
